title: Favorite early clarinet players: Noon, Vean and Zooey Sullen's band
summary: Robinson names clarinetists from before his time, the band Sidney Vean played in, and where Jimmy Noon came from.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
